headline: 60kmph winds: Storm warning issued for 5 districts by evening
summary: The Meteorological Office has warned of squally winds and thunderstorms in Rangpur, Dinajpur, Pabna, Rajshahi, and Sylhet regions.
details: The Meteorological Office has issued a warning that squally winds may blow at speeds of 45 to 60 kmph in five districts of the country by this evening.
caption:
60kmph winds and thunderstorms are expected in 5 districts by this evening. Stay safe!
